craft_notes: Sthāyin: Vismaya at unknowable workings, settling into plea. End-dash→colon (teeming stated, hail released). Rejected: 'hail!' shout — plain kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: In hymn and heed, in muse, in sight, in touch, in advent teeming:
to Bliss-bulk, to Beloved, to Braid-crowned — hail.
l4.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ stutau smṛtau dhyāne darśane sparśane tathā prāptau cānandavṛndāya dayitāya kapardine

reads_against.argmap: Bow in praise, remembrance, meditation, seeing, touch, likewise attainment. → Bow everywhere to the beloved bliss-mass, matted-haired.
c1_essence: Power-creeper blooming as gods protects; Mṛḍa errorless, reachless, praised everywhere.

l2.plain_english: Homage in hymn and memory, in meditation, sight, touch, and likewise in arrival — to the beloved mass of bliss, the matted-haired.
l2.sanskrit_cite: namaḥ stutau smṛtau dhyāne darśane sparśane tathā prāptau cānandavṛndāya dayitāya kapardine
